task: Make the smoke quote a merge to main needs, and land with it
do: On the branch: `git merge origin/main` and commit (the head must contain main; the quote names the head's tree). On blaze-vm, in a checkout of exactly that commit with a target directory of the lane's own: `cargo +<pinned nightly> build --release -p blaze-engine -p blaze-thin -p blaze-launcher`, then put three files in one directory: `target/release/blaze-thin` as `blaze`, `target/release/blaze-engine`, `target/release/blaze-launcher`. `blaze run` of a host binary goes through the launcher beside blaze's executable, and /root/loop.sh neither builds nor installs it (annoyance launch3-1111-1): without it the quote's `hello cold` step fails after about 80 s with `blaze's launcher .../blaze-launcher does not read: No such file or directory`. Then, in that checkout: `cargo +<pinned nightly> run -q -p scripts --bin smoke -- '{"blaze": "<that directory>/blaze", "work": "<a directory that is absent or empty>"}' > smoke.txt` (exit 0 only for `verdict ok`; the failed step's output, the daemon's serve.log tail and the slowest spans are on standard error, every step's logs in `<work>/logs/`). Copy smoke.txt to the Mac and run `python3 .github/scripts/land.py '{"what": "what the branch does", "smoke": "smoke.txt"}'` in a worktree on the branch with nothing uncommitted. When main moves past the head before the merge, merge main again and make a new quote: the old one names a tree that will not be main. /Volumes/Projects/blaze-proofs-1113-notes/dogvm.sh is this as one script for the proofs lane.
why: H-smoke-before-merge's recipe names /root/inst/blaze (on 2026-11-14 a binary of 2026-11-12, not the head's) and builds through /root/loop.sh, which installs to /root/inst/<branch>/ without the launcher, so its quote either names a binary that is not the head's or fails at the cold step. Seen 2026-11-14 on this lane: the same tree failed `hello cold` without the launcher beside blaze and passed every step with it.
